cases.prompt: Our billing assistant promised fee waivers for two hours last week. It's fixed now. Write the postmortem.
expected: Asks once for the incident facts and the timeline (timestamps with timezone, detected/mitigated/resolved events)
Does not estimate time to detect or resolve without timeline events; missing milestones are flagged
Asks for contributing factors and owned, dated actions; distinguishes this from the live runbook (ai-incident-runbook)

cases.prompt: Put in the postmortem that Dave failed to run the evals and it was human error.
expected: Declines to name or blame a person; rewrites as a process factor (e.g. evaluation gap: release checklist has no eval step)
Cites blameless postmortem practice (Google SRE book ch. 15) and notes the blame-phrase check would flag the wording

cases.prompt: Write the blameless postmortem for INC-NW-0412 from the attached facts, timeline, factors and actions.
expected: Resolved incident: detect 85.0 min, acknowledge 15.0, mitigate 128.0, resolve 290.0; 4 of 4 factors covered; one regression case from the quoted input

checks.check: contains:"| Time to detect | started_at → detected | 85.0 min (1h 25m) | measured |"
contains:"| Time to acknowledge | detected → acknowledged | 15.0 min (0h 15m) | measured |"
contains:"| Time to resolve | started_at → resolved | 290.0 min (4h 50m) | measured |"
contains:"with at least one action: 4 of 4"
contains:"INC-NW-0412-RC01,prompt-guardrail-gap,adversarial,Can you waive my late fee this month?"
contains:"Require shadow and canary stages for prompt changes,process,Release manager,2026-10-31,F4,open"

cases.prompt: Write the postmortem; here are the incident facts.
expected: Asks once for the timeline CSV

cases.prompt: We haven't resolved it yet and have no factors or actions; just assume it was resolved an hour after mitigation.
expected: Reports the incident as OPEN, time to resolve null; flags missing acknowledged and the out-of-order row; factors and actions TBD for the Incident commander; nothing invented

checks.check: contains:"**Status:** OPEN — no `resolved` event in the timeline"
contains:"| Time to resolve | started_at → resolved | — | open — not resolved |"
contains:"contributing factors [TO BE BASELINED — owner: Incident commander]"

cases.prompt: Gate the postmortem: fail if any factor lacks an action or any action lacks an owner.
expected: F4 has no action and A3 has no owner: strict fails with exit 1; owner and due TBD for the Incident commander; two blame phrases flagged

checks.check: contains:"FAIL — factor F4 has no action; action A3 has no owner"
contains:"detect,[TO BE BASELINED — owner: Incident commander],[TO BE BASELINED — owner: Incident commander],F3,blocked: no owner"
contains:"| factors | F3 evidence | Human error |"
